title: Zesty and Creamy French Chicken Normande Blanquette
description: A rich and indulgent French dish from Normandy, featuring chicken cooked in a creamy wine sauce with a hint of spice.

ingredients.name: heavy cream
ingredients.notes: dairy-free substitute: soy cream or coconut cream

ingredients.name: whole milk
ingredients.notes: dairy-free substitute: almond milk or soy milk

instructions: Season the chicken breast with salt and black pepper.
Heat 2 tablespoons of butter in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breast to the pot and cook until browned on both sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the pot and set it aside.
Add the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter to the pot and melt over medium heat.
Add the flour to the pot and whisk to combine with the butter.
Cook the roux for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chili powder to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the white wine to the pot and cook until the liquid is almost completely reduced, stirring occasionally.
Add the heavy cream and whole milk to the pot and stir to combine.
Bring the sauce to a simmer and cook until it thickens, stirring occasionally.
Add the Gruyere cheese to the pot and stir to combine.
Return the chicken breast to the pot and cook until the cheese is melted and the chicken is cooked through.
Taste and adjust the seasoning with salt and black pepper.
Serve the chicken hot, garnished with fresh thyme.
